reviews.author: Ramesh
reviews.title: Best in the market
reviews.body: Excellent Quality and Service from Zewa Feeds. I've been using Zewa Feeds for a while now, and I can confidently say their products are top-notch. The feed is always fresh, consistent in quality, and has made a noticeable difference in the health and productivity of my livestock. Highly recommended for anyone looking for premium feeds nutrition!

reviews.author: subir das
reviews.title: Definitely worth the price!
reviews.body: My guppies absolutely loved this food! The high-quality ingredients make it a healthy and nutritious choice for them. Definitely worth the price and highly recommended!

reviews.author: soumya
reviews.title: Must buy - guppies colour and grow big size
reviews.body: Must buy for guppy fish. Excellent color and growth results.

reviews.author: Kapil Choudhary

reviews.body: My betta is only eating live feed so he is not eating this or any other fish food but my guppies and Molly fishes loving it.

reviews.author: Aswin
reviews.title: Food quality
reviews.body: Value for money. Fish enjoying their meal. Difference are visible before and after the food. But it takes 3-4 weeks.

reviews.body: Nice but rate is very high. Fish is healthy but colour is not very good. Size is very good.

reviews.title: Beta fish eats happily
reviews.body: After one week I can say, my beta fish is eating them. Impact is under study.

reviews.author: Juhil Mondal
reviews.title: Very good product
reviews.body: It's a very good product. My betta was enjoy to eat.

reviews.author: Deroots
reviews.title: Good slow sinking fish feed
reviews.body: Good food quality and the fishes like it. These are slow sinking so good for the fishes and doesn't pollute the tank.

reviews.author: HARSHA P P
reviews.title: Best feed for cichlids
reviews.body: Ideal for wide ranges of cichlids. Great for colours and keeps water quality.

reviews.author: Praveen
reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.body: One of the best granular feed for Malawi Cichlids. They are somewhat slow sinking, keeps fishes healthy and colourful.

reviews.author: seshu
reviews.title: Good product and good packaging
reviews.body: The fish feed arrived on time and was very well packaged. The quality looks excellent, and my fish seem to enjoy it. Overall, I'm happy with the purchase - good product and good packaging. Would definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Ashish
reviews.title: Good feed for big fishes
reviews.body: My 10" Oscars love these dried worms. Good product, go for it for big/monster fishes. Only one thing to keep in mind, pre-soak the feed for 15-20 minutes or else it causes bloating.

reviews.author: Sumit kumar
reviews.title: BSFL
reviews.body: It's my first time buying BSFL so I cannot compare it but it is clean and my fish loved it.

reviews.author: Raj
reviews.title: My fishes are taking it aggressively
reviews.body: My Malawis are loving it. Using as treats for last one month, they love it always. Need more time to see long term results.

reviews.author: Davis
reviews.title: Good treat food for Oscar
reviews.body: Best to give as treat. Fishes were attacking this food. Looks to be slightly high protein so giving now once a day.

reviews.author: Raj
reviews.title: Great quality feed - my fish love it!
reviews.body: I've been feeding these pellets to my tetras for about a week now, and the results are honestly impressive. The pellet size is perfect - just right for them to consume easily without any waste. From day one, the fish started eating them eagerly, and I've already noticed a boost in their activity levels. Their colors are also looking more vibrant and lively. Will definitely be buying again!

reviews.author: Deroots
reviews.title: Slow sinking feed
reviews.body: The best slow sinking feed till now. The fishes absolutely love the feed and the packaging is great. Would be trying other fish feed also from Zewa soon.

reviews.author: Gopal Das
reviews.title: No doubt, good food for tetra
reviews.body: Nice product, it's have the quality. Fish growth is nice and they also likes the food. But MFG date is not showing properly in the bottle.

reviews.author: Bonafide
reviews.title: Worth trying it atleast!
reviews.body: Whatever the reviews may be, personally my tetra fishes are feeding well so no complain.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.title: Doesn't make tank muddy
reviews.body: Doesn't make the tank muddy.

reviews.author: James
reviews.title: All feed gone in seconds. Perfect size
reviews.body: Trying this new product first time. Have used old version, but these are better sized and more readily accepted by all my gold fish varieties.

reviews.author: Deroots
reviews.title: Less water pollution
reviews.body: Love to see the Koi feed from Zewa list on Amazon. Have been using the feed for last 6 months and the results are amazing. Water pollution is much less and the feed is water stable and Koi's love the feed.

reviews.author: Raj
reviews.title: Good feed for increased activity and health
reviews.body: Carps are aggressively taking this and showing higher activity levels. Water quality is good and need more time to see long term benefits.

reviews.author: NABANIL P.
reviews.title: Good food for small fishes
reviews.body: Food is good and totally dust form. Especially suitable for baby fries along with small fishes such as mollies, tiger barbs, guppies etc. Water quality remains neutral. I will rate 4.3 out of 5.

reviews.author: Vidushi.R
reviews.title: Go for it - been using it for a year now!
reviews.body: My fishes love it so much I'm on my second batch of this food. I've been using it for a year and all my fishes are healthy. Also it's only for smaller fish that's why the pellets are small because they can't eat bigger betta pellets. It's really good.

reviews.author: Excellent Purchase
reviews.title: Good..
reviews.body: My fishes indeed liked the food. But, pallet size is pretty small than expected. This size ideally be useful to babies with small mouth.

reviews.author: King Arthur
reviews.title: It is good food. I tried and I got fins
reviews.body: Crush and give it to fry... They fight to get it.

reviews.author: Godwin
reviews.title: Good
reviews.body: Good. Not changing the water color.

reviews.author: Darren sohkhlet
reviews.title: Best for herbivorous algae eaters
reviews.body: The food is solely meant for plecos. My goldfish and widow tetras sometimes consume a few pellets but it doesn't harm them. The pellets immediately sink to the bottom. This is perfect for plecos, bristlenose plecos, river loaches and other bottom feeders.

reviews.author: Harsh vaskar
reviews.title: Breeder's opinion on this food
reviews.body: Absolute best. It turns into powder within 5mins so pleco babies eat quite easily. Growth of babies is comparable to hikari and it doesn't make them bloat like hikari. After using this my pleco fry mortality is less than 5%.

reviews.author: Kshyanaprava Mishra
reviews.title: Bon Appetite - Affordable
reviews.body: A must have delicacy for bottom dwellers. My Red cherry shrimps are taking it on alternative days and gobbling the whole thing. The size of the pellets are same as conventional pellets and they sink to the bottom immediately. The packaging is also great.

reviews.author: Andy
reviews.title: Good product
reviews.body: Good quality, submersible food. Sinks to the bottom. Fish seem to like it.

reviews.author: Ranjith
reviews.title: Good
reviews.body: It's fine small, slowly sinking food. Liked by my fishes.

reviews.author: Sebastian
reviews.title: Ideal food for premium cherry red ornamental shrimps
reviews.body: This is ideal for premium cherry red, blue and yellow ornamental shrimps. They are eating it like crazy and growth is great so far with my small ones.

reviews.author: Dr. B. Roy
reviews.title: Happy with the purchase
reviews.body: Shrimps are growing very fast. Nice food.

reviews.author: seshan

reviews.body: Nice product. Shrimps love it.

reviews.author: v munna

reviews.body: Water is crystal clear.

reviews.author: Faseel Anwar
reviews.title: Good product
reviews.body: Good shrimp food.

reviews.author: Ananthu
reviews.title: My flowerhorn is absolutely loving this!
reviews.body: I have an 8 inch FH and he was used to some of best imported feeds since a child. Thought he wouldn't take natural food but he is now all over it. Visible difference in activity and colours. But he took a bit of time to adjust though, around 3-4 days had to give in parallel with other foods. But now he is not touching any old foods.
